sloka: पूर्णे वर्ष सहस्रे दश ऊने रघुनंदन ।दितिः परम संहृष्टा सहस्राक्षम् अथ अब्रवीत् ॥१-४६-१२॥
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣa sahasre daśa ūne raghunaṁdana ।ditiḥ parama saṁhṛṣṭā sahasrākṣam atha abravīt ॥1-46-12॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus ten years before completion of a thousand years. Diti, highly pleased with the services rendered by Indra, addressed him", saying:
